description: The finite rank (OPEN) gives well-founded actual grounding (ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF-FROM-FINITE-RANK), and with excluded middle the proved equivalence borrowingEscapeWFEquivalence turns that into the no-self-contained-borrowing cut: every nonempty set of actual concreta contains a source or the effect of a record whose contributors all lie outside it. It does not use STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF as a premise, so it adds no cycle with ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF-FROM-BORROWING-CUT.
